description: “Basement excavation with front and rear lightwell; erection of a ground floor rear extension with sukkah roof; part first floor rear extension; front and rear dormer”
decision_conditions: <p>The proposal, by reason of the provision of substandard accommodation in the basement kitchen (kitchen over 30sqm), fails to provide sufficient light and outlook and results in a substandard form of accommodation to the detriment of its occupiers, contrary to policy D6 (Housing quality and standards) of the London Plan (2021), policy LP17 (Housing Design) of the Hackney Local Plan LP33 (2020), the&nbsp; Residential Extensions and Alterations SPD (2009) and the GLA's Technical housing standards – nationally described space standards (2015).</p>

The proposed front lightwell, by reason of its size and depth, results in the loss of over 50% of the front garden area, resulting in a harmful impact on the character and appearance of the host property and the terrace it forms part of.&nbsp; As such, the proposed development is contrary to policies D3 and D4 of the London Plan (2021), policy LP1 and LP17 of the Hackney Local Plan 2033 (2020), and the guidance contained within Hackney Residential Extensions and Alterations SPD (2009).&nbsp;

The development fails to provide sufficient information to address the impacts of the proposal on the existing vegetation at the site, resulting in an overall loss of biodiversity, at the front and rear of the site, with no tree survey submitted to demonstrate otherwise. As such, the proposal is contrary to policies LP47 (Biodiversity and Sites of Importance of Nature Conservation), LP51 (Tree Management and Landscaping),of the Hackney Local plan LP33 (2020) and policies G1 (Green infrastructure, G6 (Biodiversity and access to nature) of&nbsp;the London Plan (2021).

<p>The proposed front lightwell, by reason of its excessive size and overall depth, results in the loss of over half the front garden and, as such, has a harmful impact on the appearance of the property and the street scene. As such, the proposal fails to comply woth policies D1 (<span id="docs-internal-guid-38c8a713-7fff-f276-ce9f-a7d663bb26f2"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">London’s form, character and capacity for growth),</span></span>&nbsp;D3 (<span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">Optimising site capacity through the design-led approach</span>) and D4 (Delivering good design) of the London Plan (2021) and polciies LP1 (Design Quality and Local Character) and LP17 (Housing Design) of the Hackney Local Plan LP33 (2020) and Hackney's Residential Alterations and Extensions SPD (2009).&nbsp;</p><p><span id="docs-internal-guid-443fc0cd-7fff-8781-bdd9-ef46f0f3be27"></span><br></p>
